summary: The registrant filed an 8-K announcing regular monthly distributions (Class I $0.2000, Class S $0.1815 net, Class D $0.1946 net) payable June 30, 2026, with a distribution reinvestment plan. It also disclosed April 30, 2026 NAV per share ($26.10), aggregate NAV ($1,625.2M), portfolio fair value ($3,053.2M), and debt-to-equity ratio (0.91x). The continuous offering update shows shares issued across three classes. This is a routine periodic disclosure of dividends and NAV; no special-situation event occurred.
